aboutGame.title: What is Abyssal Escape?
paragraphs: Abyssal Escape is a Roblox asymmetrical horror game in which a team of customizable Survivors works against a single Killer. Survivors dispel red mist across the map to shorten the escape timer, while the Killer uses a three-phase evolution path and role-specific abilities to interrupt that work before the escape ring appears.

Each Survivor vessel combines appearance with a two-ability loadout unlocked through rings earned in trials. Matches run on a ten-minute clock: mist nodes remove roughly 40 to 50 seconds, Killer power spikes arrive around the eight- and six-minute marks, and the highlighted escape ring opens the only Survivor win condition at the final minute.

modules.name: Abyssal Escape Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the core round loop, Survivor and Killer roles, red mist objectives, and escape timer mechanics before your first match.

highlights.detail: Build a Survivor around one clear job, then use the second ability slot to cover a different failure state.
Dispel red mist to shorten the escape timer; staying hidden does not move the clock.
Before holding an interaction, choose the exit route you will take when the Killer arrives.
Treat the final minute as ring time: stop mist work and commit to the highlighted escape path.

modules.name: Abyssal Escape Killers
modules.description: Compare the launch Killer roster, their signature threats, evolution phases, and the playstyle each one rewards.

highlights.label: 2011x
highlights.detail: Straight-line chase pressure with a powerful late-phase scaling curve.

highlights.label: Furnace
highlights.detail: Heat-driven flamethrowers and thruster flight control space and corridors.

highlights.label: Deity
highlights.detail: Ring traps, decoys, and Phase 3 flight reward careful map reads.

highlights.label: Fleetway
highlights.detail: Aerial detection and long-range laser pressure punish open escape routes.

highlights.label: Innocence
highlights.detail: A transforming, dash-heavy moveset pressures Survivors after the mid-round shift.

highlights.label: 2017X
highlights.detail: A Phase 3 beast form adds heavy slam damage to an already aggressive kit.

modules.name: Abyssal Escape Survivor Guide
modules.description: Cover Survivor customization, two-ability loadouts, teamwork, mist routing, and the final escape ring.

highlights.detail: Create a custom vessel and equip two abilities; pair one escape tool with one team tool.
Scout mist clusters in pairs so one player can watch the approach lane while the other clears.
Rotate away from the Killer's last known position and finish started nodes before opening new ones.
Save mobility for the final ring dash and treat the two-minute mark as your soft rotation deadline.

modules.name: Abyssal Escape Killer Tier List
modules.description: A starter-focused ranking of Killer archetypes by ease of learning, chase reliability, and recovery from mistakes.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Straightforward chase kits teach loops, timing, and commitment with the fewest moving parts.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Area-control kits forgive imperfect aim and reward consistent map pressure.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Ambush and stealth kits reward patience but punish early detection and missed setup.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Multi-phase and setup-heavy kits demand timing and map knowledge before they feel reliable.

modules.name: Abyssal Escape Tips and Strategies
modules.description: Apply practical Survivor and Killer advice for mist routing, chase timing, loadouts, and the final escape ring.

highlights.label: Scout
highlights.detail: Spend the opening seconds locating mist clusters before committing to a route.

highlights.label: Pair Up
highlights.detail: Clear nodes in pairs so one Survivor can watch the approach lane.

highlights.label: Finish
highlights.detail: A partial mist node removes no time, so return to finish what you started.

highlights.label: Rotate
highlights.detail: Move away from the Killer's last known position instead of clearing nearby nodes.

highlights.label: Ring
highlights.detail: At one minute remaining, abandon mist work and run the highlighted escape ring.

highlights.label: Stamina
highlights.detail: Running regenerates stamina; ability activations and maneuvers are the real costs.

faq.title: Abyssal Escape FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Abyssal Escape.

items.question: What is Abyssal Escape?
items.answer: Abyssal Escape is a Roblox asymmetrical horror game where customizable Survivors work together against one Killer. The Survivors clear red mist to shorten the escape timer, while the Killer evolves through three phases and tries to stop them before the escape ring opens.

items.question: What do Survivors do in Abyssal Escape?
items.answer: Survivors scout the map, clear red mist nodes in pairs, and rotate away from the Killer. Each fully cleared node removes roughly 40 to 50 seconds from the Abyssal Escape round clock.

items.question: How long is an Abyssal Escape match?
items.answer: An Abyssal Escape round starts with a ten-minute timer. Killer power spikes arrive around eight and six minutes remaining, and the escape ring appears during the final minute.

items.question: How many abilities can a Survivor equip in Abyssal Escape?
items.answer: A Survivor vessel in Abyssal Escape can equip two abilities unlocked with rings earned across trials. Equipping two stun-focused abilities cuts the stun duration of both by 50 percent, so most builds pair one stun with mobility or utility.

items.question: When does the escape ring appear in Abyssal Escape?
items.answer: The highlighted escape ring appears with 60 seconds remaining in Abyssal Escape. Survivors should stop clearing mist at that point and commit to the ring, because entering it is the only Survivor win condition.

items.question: How do Killers evolve in Abyssal Escape?
items.answer: Abyssal Escape Killers gain their first major power spike around eight minutes remaining and reach Phase 3 around six minutes remaining. Those phases can add upgraded chase tools, speed boosts, flight, or complete moveset transformations.

items.question: Does Abyssal Escape have redemption codes?
items.answer: No public Abyssal Escape redemption code list is documented for the current alpha. Check the official Abyssal Escape social account and Discord announcements for any future code system or reward event.
